visualCharacteristics: Statement intro band: large display title, short 48px rule and lead paragraph(s); ice, dark and simple text variants.
contentPattern: One cell: optional eyebrow paragraph, leading heading(s) as title, then paragraphs/lists/CTAs as the lead.
usage: Use at the top of plain, legal or listing pages for a title with a short lead statement.
reuseGuidance: Reuse as the page intro by authoring a heading and lead text, choosing simple for legal pages or plain-lead for listings.
